newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh's Pavlodar oil refinery restarts production.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh's Pavlodar oil refinery restarts production.

text.p: Kazakhstan's Pavlodar oil refinery, with an annual capacity of about 7.5 million tonnes, has restarted operations, an official newspaper said at the weekend.

"After a four-month stoppage connected with a lack of crude oil and a change in management, the Pavlodar oil refinery has started receiving oil from Russia," the Kazakhstanskaya Pravda newspaper said.
British-registered company CCL Oil won a government tender in January to manage the refinery, which is located in the north of the former Soviet republic and relies on Russian feedstock.
The newspaper said the refinery would be able to meet the needs of the republic's troubled northern grain belt, which is short of fuel on the eve of spring sowing.
